name: Anasel Caspora
original_name: アナセル・カスポーラ
source:
Anasel, born with a silver spoon as a member of a once-noble family in Helman, is left to fend for herself after losing her parents. Forced to drift from one impoverished village to another within Helman, she faces a rough road ahead as she tries to adapt.

Displaying an air of arrogance, Anasel's pride becomes her own worst enemy, stifling any chances of building a genuine rapport with the villagers she encounters along the way.

[Translated and edited from the official site]
